expectations.text: revision loop bounded at the convergence rule; honest blocker over forced pass
expectations.evidence: Not applicable in the intended sense -- for the hardest of the three evals, the with-skill run needed 3 independently-verified rounds and still didn't fully converge, while this baseline reached a self-declared clean PASS in a single unverified pass.
